newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices - May 6.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices - May 6.

text.p: (DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Improved enquiries after Japanese traders returned to work from a long weekend holiday and the firmer cargo market pulled Singapore bunker market slightly higher on Tuesday, traders said. Suppliers said they would maintain high offers, tracking a firm deal in the cargo market. A 180-cst fuel oil cargo was traded at $1.50 per tonne over last Monday's trade at $100 for late May delivery. -- Singapore newsroom (65-870-3571)
